chunks: As for the right of your child, know that he is from you and is ascribed to you in the immediate affairs of this world, both for his good and his evil. And you are questioned about what was entrusted to you regarding him: good upbringing, guiding him to his Lord, and assisting him in obeying Him. So act in his affairs as one who knows he will be rewarded for doing good to him and punished for doing evil to him.
ai.seo_question: What are the key responsibilities of a parent towards their child according to Shia Islamic teachings?
ai.summary: Imam Zayn al-Abidin frames parenthood as a divine trusteeship (amanah) where the parent is accountable for both the child's moral character (husn al-adab) and their spiritual orientation toward the Creator. This passage underscores the dual nature of parental responsibility, balancing worldly care with the ultimate goal of guiding the child to obedience of God, reflecting the Shia emphasis on active, conscious stewardship in family life.
